metadata.title: Odell, Oster, Alberch & Burnside (1981) Dev. Biol. & Martin, Kaschube & Wieschaus (2009) Nature Viscoelastic Stretch-Activated Apical Purse-String Constriction and Epithelial Ventral Furrow Invagination Reference Dataset
metadata.organism: Drosophila melanogaster (ventral furrow gastrulation) & Strongylocentrotus purpuratus (archenteron invagination)

sources.citation: Odell GM, Oster G, Alberch P, Burnside B (1981). The mechanical basis of morphogenesis. I. Epithelial folding and morphogenesis. Developmental Biology 85(2):446-462.
Martin AC, Kaschube M, Wieschaus EF (2009). Pulsed contractions of an actin-myosin network drive apical constriction. Nature 457(7228):495-499.
Conte V, Munoz JJ, Miodownik M (2008). A 3D finite element model of ventral furrow invagination in the Drosophila melanogaster embryo. J. Mech. Behav. Biomed. Mater. 1(2):188-198.

Polyakov O, He B, Swan M, Shaevitz JW, Kaschube M, Wieschaus E (2014). Passive mechanical forces control cell-shape change during Drosophila ventral furrow formation. Biophysical Journal 107(4):998-1010.

drosophila_ventral_furrow_specimen.species: Drosophila melanogaster gastrulating embryo (Blue DAPI nuclei, Green Neurotactin cell membranes, Red Myosin II heavy chain apical enrichment)

governing_equations.section: Odell et al. (1981) Dev. Biol. 85:446-462 Eqs. 1-6; Martin et al. (2009) Nature 457:495-499 Figs. 1-4; Polyakov et al. (2014) Biophys. J. 107:998-1010

bistable_apical_purse_string_ode.formula: tau_0 * dL_{0,i}/dt = -(L_{0,i} - L_target(L_{ap,i})),  L_target(L_{ap,i}) = L_1 if L_{ap,i} <= L_thresh else L_2 (0 < L_2 < L_1)
bistable_apical_purse_string_ode.description: Odell et al. (1981) stretch-activated apical actomyosin purse-string rest-length contraction coupled with Martin et al. (2009) Twist-driven myosin pulses (period ~82 s) and Snail-mediated ratchet stabilization.

incompressible_cytoplasmic_area_and_wedg.description: Incompressible cell volume (2D cross-sectional area A_i = A_0 = 262.4 um^2) forces apically constricting cells (L_{ap,i} < L_{bas,i}) to elongate apicobasally and adopt a wedge geometry with positive inward spontaneous curvature kappa_i > 0.

martin_odell_experimental_regimes.section: Martin, Kaschube & Wieschaus (2009) Nature 457:495-499 Figs. 1-4; Odell, Oster, Alberch & Burnside (1981) Dev. Biol. 85:446-462 Figs. 6-9

regimes.label: Wild-Type (Intact Twist Pulses + Snail Ratchet + Stretch Propagation, N_meso=16)
Stretch-Propagation Blockade (Central Initiators Only, N_init=6, L_thresh -> inf)
snail Mutant (Twist Myosin Pulses Without Ratchet Stabilization)
twist; snail Double Mutant / Y-27632 ROCK Inhibition Negative Control (No Constriction)
